app.title: Shopping list
app.description: Shared shopping list, offline, no server.

list.emptyHint: The first item will be remembered for your next shopping trips.

clearListConfirm.one: Remove {{count}} item from the list? The history is kept.
clearListConfirm.other: Remove all {{count}} items from the list? The history is kept.

addBar.emptyHistory: Nothing in the history yet. Type an item and it will be there next time.

product.title: Product
product.missing: This product doesn't exist any more
product.missingHint: It may have been archived from the other phone.
product.label: Name
product.descriptionHint: What tells this product apart from another with the same name.
product.photoHint: Shrunk to 160 px and encoded as WebP: a few kilobytes, synced separately from the list.
product.photoWins: An image is used instead of the emoji.
product.bankNoResult: No image found. Try a more common, or more specific, word.
product.bankHint: Royalty-free photos from Open Food Facts, Wikimedia Commons and Openverse. Once chosen, the image is shrunk and kept on the device: it stays visible offline.

catalog.title: History
catalog.emptyHint: Every item you add to the list goes in automatically. It will help build your next shopping trips.
catalog.noMatchHint: Try another word, or show archived products.

pairing.title: Sync
pairing.scanHint: Point at the QR code shown on the other phone.
pairing.qrWarning: This code carries the access token. Don't photograph it, and don't leave it lying around in a shared album.
pairing.offline: Offline — changes will go out when the network is back.

failed.one: Sync is down — {{count}} change kept on this device.
failed.other: Sync is down — {{count}} changes kept on this device.

pairing.lead: The list syncs through a private GitHub repository that belongs to you. No server, no subscription.
pairing.scanOther: Scan the QR code on the other phone
pairing.tokenHint: A fine-grained token with the “Contents: Read and write” permission on this repository only.
pairing.nearbyLead: Deep in an aisle where nothing gets through, the two phones can exchange their changes by QR code.

nearby.title: Nearby exchange
nearby.lead: With no network at all, the two phones exchange their changes by QR code. Three codes, two scans.
nearby.decide: Decide who starts: one shows, the other scans.
nearby.otherStarts: The other starts — scan their code
nearby.noCamera: This browser can't read QR codes: the other phone has to do the scanning.
nearby.framePosition: Screen {{position}} of {{total}} — let it run, it loops.
nearby.doneTitle: Both lists are up to date.
nearby.donePutAway: You can put the phones away.
nearby.showFirst: Have the other phone scan this code.
nearby.showLast: Have this last code scanned. The exchange will then be complete.
nearby.scan: Scan the code shown on the other phone.
nearby.showThenWait: Have the other phone scan this code, then wait for theirs.

camera.previewFailed: The camera preview could not be started. Enter the details by hand.

scan.unsupportedBrowser: This browser can't read QR codes. Enter the details by hand.
scan.unsupportedDevice: Reading QR codes isn't available on this device. Enter the details by hand.

pairing.invalidCode: This code is not a valid pairing.

github.tokenInvalid: The GitHub token is invalid or has expired.
github.tokenForbidden: The GitHub token has no rights on this repository.
github.repoNotFound: Repository not found: {{owner}}/{{repo}}. Check the name, and that the token covers this repository.
github.publishFailed: Could not publish after {{attempts}} attempts: the repository is being changed constantly.

nearby.wrongStep: This code doesn't match this step of the exchange.
nearby.corrupted: Corrupted read. Start the exchange over.
nearby.incomplete: The exchange was interrupted: one screen wasn't read. Nothing was lost — both lists are unchanged.
nearby.tooLarge: Too much data for a QR exchange ({{frames}} screens). Do it again with a network.

imageBank.noProvider: No image bank answered. Try again later.
imageBank.thumbnailFailed: That image could not be downloaded.
